English: When you recover HP, deal &a<color=#FF7A33>(60% of ATK)</color> damage to all enemies (triggers up to 10 times per turn).
Chinese: 当自己回复生命值时，对所有敌人造成&a<color=#FF7A33>(攻击力的60%)</color>伤害（1回合最多触发10次）。

English: When you recover HP, grant all allies +1 ATK and +1 Max HP for this battle.
Chinese: 当自己回复生命值时，使所有队员在本场战斗中获得+1攻击力和+1最大生命值。

English:
When you recover HP:

If this is the 1st recovery this turn, deal &a damage<color=#FF7A33>(100% of ATK)</color> to a random enemy.

If this is the 2nd recovery, add a 0-cost 'Sacred Flame Tiger' to your hand.

If this is the 3rd recovery, grant a random ally Invincible for 1 turn.
Chinese:
当自己回复生命值时，如果该回复为自己本回合中的第1次，则会对随机敌人造成&a伤害<color=#FF7A33>(攻击力的100%)</color>；
如果为第2次，则会将1个0费的“圣炎猛虎”加入手中；
如果为第3次，则会使随机1个队友无敌1回合。

English: When you recover HP, grant all allies +1 ATK and +1 Max HP for this battle.
Chinese: 当自己回复生命值时，使所有队员在本场战斗中获得+1攻击力和+1最大生命值

English: At the end of the turn, restore &a HP (80% of Healing) to all Investigators. When you recover HP, deal &a damage (80% of ATK) to all enemies (triggers up to 10 times per turn).
Chinese: 回合结束时，恢复所有调查员&a体力(治疗力的80%)；当自己回复生命值时，对所有敌人造成&a伤害(攻击力的80%)，1回合最多触发10次。

English: At the end of the turn, restore &a HP (25% of Max HP).
Chinese: 回合结束时，恢复&a体力(最大体力值的25%)。

English: When you recover HP, grant all Investigators +1 ATK and +1 Max HP for this battle.
Chinese: 当自己回复生命值时，使所有调查员在本场战斗中获得+1攻击力和+1最大生命值。

English:
Elana, Purest Prayer is a support character specialized in prolonged battles.

By healing herself, she continuously stacks powerful buffs on allies to enhance their combat capabilities and survivability.
Chinese:
清纯祈祷者·耶拉是擅长长线作战的增益型辅助角色。

通过治疗自己，她能够持续为队友叠加强力的增益效果，以强化盟友的战斗能力和生存能力。

English:
Can only be used when your HP is below &a (75% of Max HP).
(120% Disruption) Stun the enemy with the highest ATK.
Heal the ally with the lowest HP by &b (180% of Healing).
Draw 2 skills.
Chinese:
仅能在自身体力低于&a时使用(自身最大体力值的75%)。
(120%干扰)眩晕攻击力最高的敌人。
治疗体力最低的友军&b点体力(治疗力的180%)。
抽取2个技能。

English: If the target's HP is below &a<color=#FF7A33>(70% of ATK)</color>, instantly defeat them.
Chinese: 如果目标生命值低于&a<color=#FF7A33>(攻击力的70%)</color>，立即死亡。

English: Heal yourself and the Investigator with the lowest HP by &a (60% of Healing).
Chinese: 治疗自己和体力最低的调查员&a体力(治疗力的60%)。

English: Encore 0 - Change to heal yourself by &b (60% of Healing).
Chinese: 激奏0 - 变为治疗自己&b体力(治疗力的60%)。

English: Overload 3 - Additionally heal &a (105% of Healing). Draw 2 skills.
Chinese: 爆能强化3 - 额外治疗&a体力(治疗力的105%)。抽取2个技能。

English: Deal &a damage (30% of ATK × number of HP recoveries this turn) to a random enemy.
Chinese: 对随机敌人造成&a伤害(本回合中自己回复生命值的次数 x 攻击力的30%)。

English:
Remove <sprite=1>Pain and <sprite=0>Debuffs from the target.
Draw 1 skill.
Chinese:
解除目标持有的<sprite=1>痛苦和<sprite=0>弱化减益。
抽取1个技能。

English:
Add a 'Lorena's Holy Water' to your hand.
When you recover HP, if this is the 2nd recovery this turn, this skill gains 'When casting: Deal &a damage (130% of ATK) to a random enemy.'
Chinese:
将1个“萝蕾娜的圣水”加入手中。
当自己回复生命值时，如果该回复为自己本回合中的第2次，则会使这个技能获得“打出时，对随机敌人造成&a伤害(攻击力的130%)”。

English:
Heal all Investigators by &a (60% of Healing). Draw 1 skill.

Overload 4 - Additionally deal &b damage<color=#FF7A33>(60% of ATK)</color>, heal &c (60% of Healing), and draw 1 more skill.
Chinese:
恢复所有调查员&a体力(治疗力的60%)。抽取1个技能。

爆能强化4 - 造成额外&b伤害<color=#FF7A33>(攻击力的60%)</color>，额外治疗&c体力(治疗力的60%)，额外抽取1个技能。

English:
When playing: Immediately restore 5 HP to all targets.
When casting: Draw 2 skills.
Chinese:
打出时立即恢复所有目标5点生命值。
释放时抽取2个技能。

English: At the start of battle, place this on top of your deck.
Chinese: 战斗开始时，放在牌库的最上方。
